subject: Based on modification indices but an error as result

messages.author: ab6a09a11a873aba
messages.subject: Based on modification indices but an error as result
parts:
Dear all,

I'm running a model with Lavaan, and in preceding steps, I noticed that some items should be related based on high modification indices. When I add the highest indicated correlations to my model, it results in the following error: 

[lavaan DEBUG] idx in TMP: i =  89 
                 lhs op                  rhs
89 T1V1occup ~~ T2V1occup
[lavaan DEBUG] idx in DEFAULT: i =  89 
    lhs   op  rhs mod.idx
NA <NA> <NA> <NA>      NA
[lavaan DEBUG] flat.idx:integer(0)


What does it mean?

Thanks in advance!
Kind regards, Ellen
